install.title: How to install
install.description: Pick the file you downloaded to see the steps.
install.label: Installation steps by file

exe.smartscreen: If Windows says it protected your PC, select More info, then Run anyway. This happens because the app is not signed with a paid certificate yet.
exe.launch: Follow the steps, then start HyperTube Music from the Start menu.

dmg.open: Open the disk image you downloaded.
dmg.drag: Drag HyperTube Music into your Applications folder.
dmg.quarantine: If macOS says the app is damaged or cannot be checked, run this command in Terminal once and open the app again. This happens because the app is not notarized by Apple yet.

appimage.run: Start the app. In most file managers you can also just double click the file.

deb.install: Install the package. Everything it needs is installed with it.
deb.launch: Start HyperTube Music from your app menu.

rpm.install: Install the package. Everything it needs is installed with it.
rpm.launch: Start HyperTube Music from your app menu.
